title: Vector-bundle descent across a two-generator almost-blowup square after Frobenius localization

standard_prerequisites.use: Characteristic-p Frobenius pullback, finite locally free modules, the explicitly defined two-generator almost-blowup square, Noetherian approximation, projective-line cohomology and formal functions. Function-levelFrobenius descent and thecolimF gluing lemma are retained.

core_obligations: Descend compatible bundle morphisms after one sufficiently high Frobenius pullback using the retained function-level descent and Zariski gluing.
For essential surjectivity, reduce to a Noetherian locally trivial closed-fibre bundle, lift its trivialization through the exceptional formal neighbourhood, and glue the resulting vector bundle.

difficulty_reason: The comparison is an equivalence only after Frobenius localization, and it must control both bundle morphisms and lifting of an actual bundle from the two pieces. These two mechanisms give an H2 descent task.
